title: Moon Gift Series
description: A reference-driven Mid-Autumn campaign system that locks a premium moon-gifting world and extends it across family and retail surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a moon-led premium gifting language built from lacquer, brushed metal, osmanthus tones, moon windows, and tea-gift refinement; images 02-04 preserve that identity while moving through family table, lantern retail, and premium hamper expressions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-mooncake-lacquer-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-family-tea-variation, 03-lantern-retail-variation, 04-premium-hamper-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-mooncake-lacquer-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
